testcase.name: Scenario: Press Escape with the command-source list open and a pending edit: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1268:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Press Escape with the command-source list open and a pending edit ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ And the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the target list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user opens the command-source list ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible ✔ When the user reopens ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools target is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the Tools ribbon remains visible
